adjudication_label: AM process parameter optimization for grain size and defect control
canonical_question: What specific processing parameters (laser power, scan speed) were used to achieve the specific combination of dislocation network, grain size, and Mn2O3 precipitates?

question_variants.question: What specific processing parameters (laser power, scan speed) were used to achieve the specific combination of dislocation network, grain size, and Mn2O3 precipitates?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The specific processing parameters (laser power: 90 W, scan speed: 600 mm/s) used to fabricate the SLM-built HEA containing the dislocation network and nano-sized Mn2O3 precipitates are explicitly provided in the evidence.

answers.answer: The SLM-built HEA with a dislocation network and nano-sized Mn2O3 precipitates was fabricated using a laser power of 90 W and a laser scanning speed of 600 mm/s.
answers.measurement_outcome: Fabricated bar-type specimens with specific microstructure
answers.mechanism: SLM processing parameters determine microstructural features
evidence_spans: The above powders were then used as feedstocks for SLM processing (model: Concept Laser Mlab cusing) under high-purity Ar gas to minimize oxidation.
A laser scanning speed of 600 mm/s was applied to fabricate bar-type specimens with dimensions of 85 mm × 10 m × 10 m.
A hatch space of 80 µm with a laser power of 90 W was applied.

source_evidence_spans: The main reason why SLM-built HEA has outstanding mechanical properties is suspected to be due to the dislocation network, fine grain size and nano-sized Mn 2 O 3
